_comment: Per-strategy disciplined-gate baseline. Each strategy's CI lower bound from the offline disciplined gate (promotion_panel 5 layers: 20y bootstrap + per-strategy slippage + block bootstrap + period stability + multi-testing). Live monitoring compares the strategy's ROLLING live PF against this baseline. Source: project_2026_05_22_backtest_factory_findings.md + 2026-05-23 audit Agent 2 slippage recalibration. Update this file when the gate is re-run against fresh evidence.
_slippage_methodology: slippage_bps_used is the bps figure that produced the published CI bounds. _slippage_bps_realistic is Agent 2's recalibration based on actual venue/instrument characteristics; until the gate is re-run at the realistic value, treat the published CI as an upper bound on edge.
generated_from: promotion_panel applied to 20y backtests + archived live trades

forge_xs_momentum.notes: Strongest config tested. Passes 8/8 layers including block bootstrap. Edge concentrates in moderate-high VIX (>=20) regimes per 5/23 audit. Monthly cadence on broad ETFs (SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/EFA/EEM/GLD/TLT) — 10bps slippage realistic at retail size.

forge_spy_trend_follower.notes: Passes 7/8 layers. H1 fails on n=5 sub-sample (sparsity, not regime). Role: defensive beta proxy not alpha. 0.614 correlation with xs_momentum. SPY is the tightest US ETF; 5bps is more realistic than the 10bps used — actual CI lower bound likely slightly higher than 2.67.

forge_gld_pm_long.notes: Fails at 5bp slippage (the realistic figure for GLD intraday). 522 trades / 2y cadence → slippage drag destroys edge. Live evidence still useful for re-evaluation as n accumulates.

forge_nq_overnight.notes: Net loser even at 3bp slippage. 713 trades / 2y. Don't promote to real money. Agent 2 5/23 audit: realistic overnight NQ/MNQ slippage is closer to 5-10bps because of widening into ETH session and the higher spread paid on MNQ vs full NQ — re-run at 7bps would push CI lower further below 1.0. Monitor live: if rolling PF >= 1.0 persistently across 50+ trades, re-evaluate.

forge_pead.notes: CI lower 1.17 — literally 0.03 below 1.20 floor at 10bps. Agent 2 5/23 audit: PEAD entries hit earnings-week wide spreads + occasional gap-fill chasing; realistic slippage is 30-50bps. Re-run at 40bps would push CI lower significantly below 1.0. Non-curated SPX-50 also fails (CI lower 1.07 at 10bps). Edge IS real in spec, sample IS too small AND realistic execution drag may eliminate it. ACTION: re-run promotion_panel at 40bps before claiming edge.
